notes.title: Digital Market Simulator Demo Update 1.1.5
notes.content:
[h2]Update Highlights:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased probability of getting customers.
[*] Improved randomness of customer purchases.
[*] Increased the volume of background music and some environmental sounds.
[*] Interaction time with the computer, cash register and box was shortened.
[*] Store level upgrade prices have been changed.
[/list]

notes.title: Digital Market Simulator Developer Gameplay
notes.content: Playing DMS Demo v1.1.0 on live stream.

notes.title: Digital Market Simulator Demo Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Update Highlights:[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added 11 new products to the E-Market.
[*]Added a bell sound when a customer approaches the cash register.
[*]Added a compass on the HUD that shows directions and fixed waypoints.
[*]Added a subtitle interface for environmental sounds and NPC dialogues.
[*]Added AMD FSR upscaler mode.
[*]Added Screen Space Global Illumination, check out Graphic Settings.
[*]Added new developer console commands (open console with F1 when developer mode is enabled).
[*]Added the ability to name your store at the start of the game.
[*]Added "stats & stats_..." commands for benchmarking.
[*]Adjusted starting money and reputation values.
[*]Adjusted the profit margin on sales to a more optimal level, now varying slightly based on the save file’s seed.
[*]Boxes can now be opened and closed while being held.
[*]Fixed timing issues in RPC (Rich Presence).
[*]Implemented level requirements for each product before it can be sold.
[*]Numeric and some other keys can now be used when near the POS device.
[*]Prevented player reputation from exceeding limits and breaking customer balance.
[*]Removed dynamic sleeping time; now sleeping always wakes you up the next morning.
[*]Restored the missing 4th store level and updated level upgrade requirements.
[*]Significant performance optimizations applied.
[*]Temporarily removed DirectX12 and Vulkan support.
[*]Added fixed waypoints for the Store and Home locations.
[*]Upgraded to a new version of Unity.
[*]The Developer Console can now only be activated by pressing F1.
[/list]

notes.title: First Bugfix + Improvement Update
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed NPCs very rarely striking weird poses.
[*] The game can now run in the background.
[*] Fixed the in-game computer's Media Player continuing to play when the game is stopped.
[*] Improvements have been made to the UI and some input barriers have been fixed.
[*] Fixed the sound of wet footstep in a certain part of the store when it rains.
[*] Prevented excessive purchases from the e-Market.
[/list]
